# Mahapatra Universal Limited

> Mahapatra Universal Limited is a diversified Indian conglomerate with seven business verticals: Financial Services, Mining, Information Technology, Hospitality, Logistics, Infrastructure, and Sports, Media & Entertainment. It builds the foundations of a stronger, more sustainable India.

Contact: contactus@mahapatrauniversal.com

## Company

- [Home](https://mahapatrauniversal.com/): Overview of the group and its seven business verticals.
- [About Us](https://mahapatrauniversal.com/about.html): Legacy, mission, values, and the seven-vertical industry spectrum.
- [Leadership](https://mahapatrauniversal.com/leadership.html): The leadership team steering the group's vision.

## Businesses

- [Our Businesses](https://mahapatrauniversal.com/business.html): Details on all seven verticals: Financial Services, Mining, Information Technology, Hospitality, Logistics, Infrastructure Development (roads, urban and housing, railways, waterways and ports, industrial infrastructure), and Sports, Media & Entertainment.
